data.one_liner: Context menu widget supporting native menus on platforms and drag & drop transitions on mobile.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single context menu widget that seamlessly transitions to native drag & drop on mobile platforms like Android and iOS. It uses native context menus on iOS, macOS, and Linux, and Flutter-based context menus on Android, Windows, and Web.
use_when: You need a cross-platform context menu that utilizes native menus on iOS, macOS, and Linux.
You want context menus that can transition into native drag and drop actions on mobile.
avoid_when: You want to avoid native dependencies like Rust or precompiled platform binaries.
Your application does not require context menus or drag and drop interactions.
strengths: Supports native context menus on iOS, macOS, and Linux.
Provides seamless transition to drag and drop on mobile devices.
Advanced features like custom lift images, deferred menu items, and lazy loading.
weaknesses: Uses Rust internally, which requires downloading precompiled binaries or setting up rustup.
First build might take longer due to Rust target and NDK dependency compilation.
data.setup_notes: Uses Rust internally. Automatically downloads precompiled binaries or builds from source if rustup is detected.
